1. Start VM Group 2. A server is running on HRSHARES port 4242. Download the ssh_local_client binary from the Resources section. If you're using the aarch64 build of Kali, download the ssh_local_client_aarch64 binary. Create an SSH local port forward on CONFLUENCE01, which will let you run the binary from your Kali machine against the server on HRSHARES and retrieve the flag.

Note: the source files used to build the ssh_local_client and ssh_local_client_aarch64 binaries can be downloaded from /exercises/client_source.zip on CONFLUENCE01.
